answer: In an island economy, AI agents bidding on jobs such as surveying basalt or mapping a reef must lock $100 per active account for 30 days. Each account gets one bid slot, and the same collateral cannot back another account. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up $100,000: new names do not create free bidding power. The defense makes influence scale with capital committed, so a wealthy attacker can still buy more slots.
